The trigger defines the event or condition that starts the flow, such as a record being created/updated, a schedule being reached, or an application event occurring. Flow logic (A) runs within the flow, subflows (B) are called by flows, and data pills (C) carry data.

questions.stem: What is the name of the string that displays filter criteria?
questions.explanation: A Breadcrumb is the string that displays filter criteria on a list. Located above the list, the breadcrumb shows the current active filter conditions in a readable format (e.g., 'State = Active ^Assignment group = Network'). Users can click on breadcrumb elements to modify or remove filter conditions.

questions.stem: Which system property is added and set to true in order to see impersonation events in the System Log?
questions.explanation: The system property glide.sys.log_impersonation must be added and set to true to see impersonation events in the System Log. This property enables logging of all impersonation activities including who impersonated whom and when, providing an audit trail for security and compliance.

questions.stem: What process allows users to create, categorize, review, approve and browse important information in a centralized location that is shared by the entire organization?
questions.explanation: Knowledge Management is the process that allows users to create, categorize, review, approve, and browse important information in a centralized location shared by the entire organization. It provides a structured approach to capturing organizational knowledge in articles that can be searched and reused.

questions.stem: A colleague wants to rearrange the columns on their My Work List. Once the user has navigated to the list, where should they navigate to select and arrange the columns?

options.text: Right click on any column header, Context Menu > Configure > List Layout
Click List Context Menu > Configure > List Layout
Click List Context Menu > Personalize List

questions.explanation: To personalize (not configure) the columns on their My Work List, the user should click 'Personalize List' directly. The Personalize List gear icon or link opens a dialog where individual users can select and arrange columns for their own view. Configure > List Layout (A, B) changes the layout for all users, while Personalize only affects the current user.

questions.stem: You are looking at a list of Active Incidents. You want to exclude Incidents with the state of Resolved. How might you do that?

options.text: On Search, select State, type not Resolved, press enter
On State column title, right-click, select Filter Out > Resolved
On the list of records, locate and right-click on the Resolved value, select Filter Out
On the list of records, locate and right-click on the Resolved value, select Exclude
Click Funnel icon, click AND, Select Resolved, is Not, State, click Run

questions.explanation: To exclude Resolved incidents from the list: locate a Resolved value in the State column, right-click on it, and select 'Filter Out'. This adds a condition to exclude records with that value. This is the fastest way to exclude specific values from a filtered list view.

questions.stem: Roles can inherit permissions from other roles. Which role inherits all of the permissions of the catalog role, and the user_criteria_admin role, plus has permissions to create Items and Services?
questions.explanation: Catalog Admin [catalog_admin] inherits all permissions from the catalog role and user_criteria_admin role, plus has permissions to create Items and Services. It is the administrative role for Service Catalog management, combining catalog usage permissions with the ability to create and manage catalog content.

questions.stem: What component of the ServiceNow infrastructure defines every table and field in the system?
questions.explanation: The Dictionary defines every table and field in the ServiceNow system. It's the metadata repository that stores the definition, type, length, and attributes of all columns across all tables. Accessible via System Definition > Dictionary, it is the central component defining the platform's data structure.

questions.stem: Which data consistency settings can be achieved using UI Policy? (Choose three.)

options.text: Setting fields to accept the data in an expected format
Setting fields to accept the data with ‘n’ number of characters

questions.explanation: UI Policy can achieve three data consistency settings: setting fields hidden/visible (C) to show or hide fields based on conditions, setting fields read-only (D) to prevent editing, and setting fields mandatory (E) to require values. UI Policy does not control data format (A) or character length (B) — those are Dictionary attributes.

questions.stem: A customer wants to use a client script to validate things on a form in order to make sure the submission makes sense. What type of client script would you recommend to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: An onSubmit() client script validates form data before the record is saved. It runs when the user clicks Save/Submit/Update, allowing you to check field values and display error messages. If the onSubmit function returns false, the submission is cancelled. This is the standard validation pattern for form submissions.

questions.stem: An order from the Service Catalog has been placed. Two records in the Platform are created as a result. Which two records are associated with this newly ordered item? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: When a Service Catalog order is placed, two records are created: a Requested Item [sc_req_item] (A) representing the specific item ordered, and a Catalog Task [sc_task] (B) representing the fulfillment work. The Request [sc_request] is also created but as a parent container. Incidents, changes, and problems are separate ITSM processes.

questions.stem: What action will allow you to personalize layouts of columns in a list?

options.text: Click Gear Icon > Personalize window options > Select the appropriate columns
Select the column to be personalized and right at the header > Choose the options to personalize
Select the column to be personalized > Click Edit icon (Pencil) > Choose the options to personalize

questions.explanation: To personalize column layouts in a list: click the Gear Icon, which opens the Personalize window with options to select and arrange the appropriate columns. The gear icon on a list provides individual users the ability to customize their column layout without affecting other users' views.

questions.stem: An order for new office equipment has been placed through the Service Catalog. How would you view the lists of requests after the orders have been placed?

options.text: In the Navigation Filter, type “requests.list" and press the Enter key
All > Service Catalog > Open Records > Items

questions.explanation: To view lists of requests after orders are placed, navigate to All > Service Catalog > Open Records > Items. This module shows the list of Requested Items (sc_req_item) that have been ordered through the catalog. While 'Requests' (C) shows the parent request records, the question specifically asks about viewing after orders are placed.

questions.stem: Which path would you take to access the table configuration page from a form?

options.text: The Form Context menu > View > Show Table
The Form Context menu > View > Table
The Form Context menu > Configure > Dictionary
The Form Context menu > Configure > Table

questions.explanation: To access the table configuration page from a form, use Form Context Menu > Configure > Table. This navigates directly to the table record where you can modify table properties including label, extends, number prefix, and other settings. Configure > Dictionary (C) goes to field definitions, not table configuration.

questions.stem: Which admin role is required to make changes to High Security Settings?
questions.explanation: The security_admin role is required to make changes to High Security Settings. This role must be elevated (activated temporarily) through the Elevate Roles option. The regular admin role (C) alone cannot modify high security settings. security_admin provides elevated privileges specifically for security-sensitive configuration changes.

questions.stem: What is the most common role that has access to almost all platform features, functions, and data?
questions.explanation: System Administrator [admin] is the most common role with access to almost all platform features, functions, and data. The role is named 'admin' in the system. Super User (A), Base Admin (D), and System Manager (E) are not real ServiceNow roles. Security Admin (B) has a typo and is specifically for security settings, not general platform access.

questions.stem: When moving multiple update sets at one time, what might you do to facilitate the move?
questions.explanation: To facilitate moving multiple update sets at once, use Batch. Batching allows you to combine multiple update sets into a single batch for streamlined migration between instances. This simplifies the retrieve-preview-commit process when dealing with many related update sets that need to be moved together.

questions.stem: What do you click when you have made modifications to your report, and you want to see the results without saving?
questions.explanation: Click 'Run' in the Report Designer to see the results of your modifications without saving. The Run button generates a preview of the report with current settings, allowing you to verify the output before committing changes. Preview (A) is not the button name in Report Designer, and Test (B), Try It (D), Execute (E) are not options.

questions.stem: Which framework can automatically populate values for the Priority and Category fields based on the Short description field value?
questions.explanation: Predictive Intelligence is the framework that automatically populates values for Priority and Category fields based on the Short Description. It uses machine learning models trained on historical data to predict field values from text input. Assignment Rules (B) handle group/user assignment, not category/priority prediction.

questions.stem: Which testing framework is used to test ServiceNow Applications?
questions.explanation: The Automated Test Framework (ATF) is the testing framework used to test ServiceNow Applications. ATF allows you to create and run automated tests for platform functionality including forms, flows, business rules, and integrations. It runs tests within the ServiceNow instance itself. JUnit (B) and Selenium (C) are external frameworks.

questions.stem: Which allows the creation of a task-based record from Service Catalog?
questions.explanation: Record Producers allow creation of task-based records from Service Catalog. Unlike regular catalog items that create Requested Items, Record Producers generate records directly on a specified target table (like Incident, Change, or custom task tables). Users interact with them through the catalog but the result is a direct task record.

questions.stem: What module do you use to access the reports that are available to you?
questions.explanation: Reports > View / Run is the module used to access reports available to you. This module displays all reports you have permission to see, organized by sections (My reports, Group, Global, All). From here you can view, run, edit, or share reports.

questions.stem: Security rules are defined to restrict the permissions of users from viewing and interacting with data. What are these security rules called?
questions.explanation: Access Control Rules (ACLs) are security rules that restrict user permissions for viewing and interacting with data. They define who can perform which operations (create, read, write, delete) on which objects (tables, fields, rows). ACLs evaluate roles, conditions, and scripts to determine whether access is granted or denied.

questions.stem: A new employee joins the IT department and needs to perform work assigned to Network and Hardware groups. How would you set up their access? (Choose three.)

options.text: Add User Account to Hardware group
Add User Account to IT Knowledgebase
Add User Account to itil group
Add User Account to Network group

questions.explanation: To set up the new employee's access: Create a User Account (C) first, then Add User Account to Network group (E) and Add User Account to Hardware group (A) so they can work on tasks assigned to those groups. The itil role (D) may come from group membership. KB access (B) and ACL (F) are not required for task assignment.

questions.stem:
The customer has asked that you change the default layout of the Task list. They would like these columns, in this order:

• Number
• Task Type
• Parent
• Short Description
• Assignment Group
• Assignee
• Updated

After navigating to the list, where would you click, to meet this requirement?

options.text: Click List Context Menu > Personalize List
Click List Context Menu > Configure > Columns
Right click List Gear icon > Configure > Columns
Right click on any column header, Context Menu > Configure > List Layout

questions.explanation: To change the DEFAULT layout of the Task list for all users: right-click on any column header, Context Menu > Configure > List Layout. This opens the list layout editor where you configure which columns appear and their order. This is a Configure action (affects all users), not Personalize (which only affects the current user).

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow capability allows you to provide knowledge articles, via a conversational messaging interface?
questions.explanation: Virtual Agent is the ServiceNow capability that provides knowledge articles via a conversational messaging interface. It uses AI-driven topic conversations to guide users through finding information, resolving issues, and accessing knowledge articles interactively. Agent Assist (A) is a sidebar tool for service agents.

questions.stem: On the Form header, which element you to access form templates?
questions.explanation: The More Options (...) icon on the form header provides access to form templates. Clicking the three-dot icon reveals options including 'Apply Template' and 'Save as Template'. The Stamp icon (A) is not a standard form element, Pages (C) is not a form icon, and Paperclip (D) is for attachments.

questions.stem: What is the definition of a group?

options.text: A collection of subject matter experts

questions.explanation: A group is defined as a collection of users. In ServiceNow, groups (sys_user_group) organize users together for work assignment, notification, and access control purposes. While groups may contain experts (A) or function as teams, the formal platform definition is a collection of users. Department (B) and collection of tasks (E) are different concepts.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow utility provides a modern interactive graphical interface to visualize configuration items and their relationships?
questions.explanation: Dependency View provides a modern interactive graphical interface to visualize configuration items and their relationships. It displays an interactive map showing upstream and downstream CI dependencies with drill-down capabilities. Business Service Map (D) is older, CI Class Map (B) shows class hierarchy, and Flow Design (A) is for flows.

questions.stem: What icon do you use to change the label on a Favorite?
questions.explanation: The Pencil icon is used to change the label on a Favorite. Clicking the pencil icon next to a favorite in the Favorites list opens an edit dialog where you can modify the favorite's display name, icon, and color. Star (A) toggles favorite on/off, Clock (B) shows history, Triangle (C) is not a standard icon.

questions.stem: Which tool is used to define relationships between fields in an import set table and a target table?
questions.explanation: A Transform Map defines relationships between fields in an import set table and a target table. It specifies how source columns from the staging table map to destination fields in the target table during the import process. Schema Map (A) shows table relationships, Field Transformer (B) and Transform Schema (D) are not standard features.

questions.stem: When moving a homepage or dashboard between instances, what must you remember?

options.text: Download both as PDF and XML files
They cannot be moved via update set
The Platform will automatically add them to the update set
Manually add them to the update set

questions.explanation: When moving a homepage or dashboard between instances, you must manually add them to the update set. Homepages and dashboards are not automatically captured in update sets when modified. You need to explicitly add them using 'Add to Update Set' from the record's context menu or related links.

questions.stem: Which allows the creation of a task-based record from Service Catalog?
questions.explanation: Record Producers allow creation of task-based records from the Service Catalog. They function like catalog items but create records directly on a specified target table (e.g., Incident, HR Case) instead of creating Requested Items. This makes them ideal for self-service incident reporting and other direct record creation use cases.

questions.stem: On the knowledge base record, which tab would you use to define which users are able to write articles to the knowledge base?
questions.explanation: The 'Can Contribute' tab on the knowledge base record defines which users are able to write articles. User Criteria specified here controls who has write/contribute access. If no criteria are set, the default contribution rules apply. 'Can Read' (C) controls viewing access, and the other options are not valid tab names.

questions.stem: Which type of scripts run in the browser?
questions.explanation: UI Policies run in the browser (client-side). They execute JavaScript on the client to control form field properties like mandatory, visible, and read-only states. Script Includes (B) run server-side, Access Control Scripts (C) run server-side during ACL evaluation, and Business Rules (D) run server-side during database operations.

questions.stem: What enables you to trace the connection from an infrastructure item, like a Server, to the Services that are dependent on that Server?
questions.explanation: Relationships enable tracing connections from infrastructure items like servers to dependent services. CI relationships stored in cmdb_rel_ci define upstream/downstream dependencies between configuration items. By following these relationship links, you can trace from a server to the business services that depend on it.

questions.stem: What section on a task record is used to see the most recent updates made to a record?
questions.explanation: The Activity Stream section on a task record shows the most recent updates made to that record. It displays a chronological feed of all changes including field updates, comments, work notes, and state transitions. Timeline (A) and Related List (B) serve different purposes, and Audit Log (D) is a system-level feature.

questions.stem: While using the CMDB, what do you call the component that needs to be managed in order to deliver services?
questions.explanation: A Configuration Item (CI) is the component in the CMDB that needs to be managed to deliver services. CIs represent hardware, software, services, or any other infrastructure element tracked in the Configuration Management Database. Assets (B) have financial context, while CIs focus on configuration and service dependency relationships.

questions.stem: What is the first step in the process to import spreadsheet data into ServiceNow?
questions.explanation: The first step for importing spreadsheet data is to Define Data Source. You must first identify and configure the data source (file type, location, format) before loading data. This step sets up the connection to the source data. Load Data comes after the data source is defined. For scheduled/recurring imports, defining the source is always first.

questions.stem: What are the steps for importing data using an import set?

options.text: Create Import Set; Create transform map; Transform data; Clean up import table
Create a Transform Map, Load Data, Transform Data, Run Transform Map Script
Identify source; Import transform map; Run transformer; Verify import
Select source file; Run AutoMap; Transform data; Clean up target table

questions.explanation: The import set process steps: Create Import Set (load the source file into a staging table), Create Transform Map (define field mappings from staging to target), Transform Data (execute the mappings), and Clean Up Import Table (remove staging data). This is the complete four-step workflow for data imports using import sets.

questions.stem: If users would like to locate and assign a task to themselves in the Platform, what action could they perform from the list view to make the assignment? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the record using the check box, then select the Person icon
Select the record using the check box then select the Assign To Me UI action on the List Header
Double click on the Assigned to value, type the name of the user, and select the green check
Right click on the Task number and select the Assign to me option in the menu
Select the Task number, and select the Assign to me UI action on the form

questions.explanation: Two ways to assign a task to yourself from the list view: double-click on the Assigned to value, type your name, and select the green check (C) for inline editing, or right-click on the Task number and select 'Assign to me' (D) from the context menu. Both allow self-assignment without opening the full record form.

questions.stem: What module enables an administrator to define destinations for imported data on any ServiceNow table?
questions.explanation: A Transform Map enables an administrator to define destinations for imported data on any ServiceNow table. Transform Maps specify how columns from the import set staging table map to fields in the target table. They are the key component that controls where imported data is written.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow capability provides assistance to help users obtain information, make decisions, and perform common work tasks via a messaging interface?
questions.explanation: Virtual Agent provides assistance via a messaging interface to help users obtain information, make decisions, and perform common work tasks. It uses conversational AI with pre-built and custom topics to guide users through self-service workflows. Agent Workspace (C) is the agent UI, not a user-facing messaging tool.

questions.stem: What instance resource allows you to access guided tours, information about actions, and instructions on how to use inputs and outputs in your flow?
questions.explanation: The Help Panel (question mark icon) provides access to guided tours, information about actions, and instructions on how to use inputs and outputs in your flow. It offers contextual help that adapts to the current page, providing relevant documentation directly within the instance without leaving the current context.

questions.stem: When importing data from a spreadsheet, which step defines where the incoming data columns will be written in the receiving table?
questions.explanation: Create Transform Map is the step that defines where incoming data columns will be written in the receiving table. The transform map establishes the mapping between source columns (from the import set staging table) and target fields (in the destination table). This determines how imported data flows from staging to the final table.

questions.stem: On a form header, what icon would you click to access Template features?
questions.explanation: The Stamp icon on the form header provides access to template features. Clicking the stamp icon lets you apply existing templates or save the current form values as a new template. Templates pre-populate form fields with predefined values. More options (D) contains other actions, Paper clip (B) is for attachments.

questions.stem: Access Control rules are applied to a specific table, like the Incident table. What is the object name for a rule that applies to the entire Incident table (all rows and fields)?
questions.explanation: The object name for an ACL that applies to the entire Incident table (all rows and fields) is incident.None. The '.None' suffix indicates a table-level rule without field-specific restrictions. This is the broadest ACL for the Incident table. incident.* (A) applies to all fields specifically, not the table as a whole.

questions.stem: On a list, what does each row show?
questions.explanation: On a list, each row shows a Record. A list view displays multiple records from a table, with each horizontal row representing one complete record. Each column in the row displays a field value for that record. Fields (D) are the columns, tables (C) are the entire data structure, and filters (A) restrict which records are shown.

questions.stem: Which action enables personalization in a form for the admin role, only?

options.text: Navigate to sys_form_properties.list and set the property glide.ui.enable_personalize_form.admin to true.
Navigate to Context Menu > Configure > Form Layout and select ‘Enable Personalization’ and Enter the ‘admin’ role.
Navigate to Context Menu > Configure > Table and add the role ‘Admin’ in the ‘Available User’ list box.
Navigate to sys_properties.list find the property glide.ui.personalize_form.role and set the Value to admin.

questions.explanation: To enable form personalization for the admin role only: navigate to sys_properties.list, find the property glide.ui.personalize_form.role, and set the Value to 'admin'. This system property controls which roles can personalize forms. Setting it to 'admin' restricts personalization to only users with the admin role.

questions.stem: Which element is used to track items not saved with a field, in a record?
questions.explanation: The Activity Formatter tracks items not saved with a field in a record, such as work notes and additional comments. It displays journal-type entries that are stored separately from the main record fields. The Activity Formatter renders the activity stream showing chronological updates, comments, and work notes on task forms.

questions.stem: What does ServiceNow recommend as a best practice regarding data imports?

options.text: Adjust your Transform maps, after the data is loaded into the target table.
Use extremely large Import Sets, instead of multiple large Import Sets.
Create a new Import set table for each new data load.
Plan time before your import to remove obsolete or inaccurate data.
Monitor data quality and clean imported data, using the Data Scrub Workspace.

questions.explanation: ServiceNow best practice for data imports: plan time before your import to remove obsolete or inaccurate data. Data cleansing before import prevents bad data from entering the system. Adjusting transform maps after loading (A) is backwards, extremely large imports (B) cause performance issues, and new import set tables for each load (C) create unnecessary tables.

questions.stem: When an administrator sets a policy that is applied to all data entered into the Platform (UI, Import Sets, or Web Services), where does this policy run by default?
questions.explanation: A Data Policy runs on the Server by default. Data Policies enforce rules server-side, applying to all data entry methods including UI forms, Import Sets, and Web Services. Because they execute server-side, they ensure consistent data enforcement regardless of the entry channel. Client-side (C/D) would only affect browser forms.

questions.stem: If a user is on an Incident form and is alerted when they change the value of the Priority field, which type of script executes in the Platform?
questions.explanation: When a user is alerted upon changing the Priority field value on an Incident form, a Client Script executes. Client scripts run in the browser and respond to form events like field changes (onChange type). This client-side interaction provides immediate feedback without a server round-trip. Business Rules (D) execute server-side on save.

questions.stem: Which feature can be used to categorize a set of records from a list and make them visible to other users?
questions.explanation: Tags are the feature used to categorize a set of records from a list and make them visible to other users. Tags are user-defined labels that can be applied to any record and shared with Me, Groups/Users, or Everyone. They provide a flexible categorization system outside of standard field values.

questions.stem: The testing team needs to be able to perform activities in the test instance, as though they are a member of the Service Desk group. What role would they need to be able to switch between user accounts, without logging out and back in?
questions.explanation: The impersonator role allows the testing team to switch between user accounts without logging out. This role grants the ability to impersonate other users, seeing the platform as they would see it. The admin role (C) also enables impersonation but grants far more permissions than needed for testing purposes.

questions.stem: What are the benefits of building flows using Flow Designer? (Choose three.)

options.text: Provides built-in libraries /API for complex coding
Provides natural-language descriptions of flow logic
Supports easy integration with 3rd party systems

questions.explanation: Benefits of Flow Designer: provides natural-language descriptions of flow logic (D) making flows readable, supports no-code application development (E) for citizen developers, and supports easy integration with 3rd party systems (F) via spokes. It does NOT provide an IDE for scripting (A), built-in coding libraries (B), or auto-populate SLA records (C).

questions.stem: Which helps to visualize configuration items and their relationships?
questions.explanation: Dependency View visualizes configuration items and their relationships. It provides an interactive graphical interface showing CI dependencies — upstream providers and downstream consumers. Tables (A) store data, Schema Map (B) shows table relationships, Flow Design (C) is for flows, and Transform Map (D) is for data imports.

questions.stem: Which tables are children of the Task table and come with the base system? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Children of the Task table that come with the base system: Problem (B), Incident (E), and Change Request (F). These three are core ITSM tables that extend Task. Config (A) is not a task child, Dictionary (C) is metadata, and cmdb (D) is the CMDB base table, not a Task child.

questions.stem: Which role(s) are required to impersonate a user? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The roles required to impersonate a user are: admin (E) which inherently has impersonation capability, and impersonator (C) which specifically grants impersonation rights without full admin access. Either role alone allows impersonation. security_admin (A) is for security settings, sys_admin (B) is not correct, and sys_user (D) is not a role.

questions.stem: Which set of steps is used to import spreadsheet data into a ServiceNow table?

options.text: Load Data, Create Transform Map, Run Transform
Define Data Source, Select Transform Map, Run Transform
Select Import Set, Select Transform Map, Run Transform

questions.explanation: The steps to import spreadsheet data: Load Data (upload the file into a staging table), Create Transform Map (define how source columns map to target fields), Run Transform (execute the mappings to write to the target table). This three-step process is the standard import set workflow for spreadsheet data.

questions.stem: What contains the configuration changes made in an instance (i.e. changes in a form) and helps to implement the changes from the Dev environment to another environment?
questions.explanation: Update Sets contain configuration changes made in an instance (form modifications, business rules, UI policies, etc.) and help implement changes from Dev to other environments. They capture customizations in a transportable package that can be retrieved, previewed, and committed on target instances for controlled change management.

questions.stem: An administrator creates “customer_table_admin” and “customer_table_user” roles for the newly created "Customer Table”. Which ACL rule would grant access to all rows and all fields to both the customer_table_admin and customer_table_user roles?
questions.explanation: The ACL rule customer.none would grant access to all rows and all fields for both roles. The '.none' suffix on an ACL indicates a table-level rule covering the entire table. However, note the table name would need to match the actual custom table name (customer in this case). Both roles would be added to this single table-level ACL.

questions.stem: Which tables are available by default in a ServiceNow instance? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Tables available by default in a ServiceNow instance: User [sys_user] (A) for user accounts, Incident [incident] (C) as a core ITSM table, and Task [task] (E) as the base work item table. Issue (B), Project (D), and Item (F) are not default base system tables — they require additional plugins.

questions.stem: In a Knowledge Base record, where can an administrator find the User Criteria for who can read the articles?
questions.explanation: The administrator can find User Criteria for who can read articles from the 'Can Read' tab on the Knowledge Base record. This tab contains the User Criteria definitions that control which users have read access to articles in that knowledge base. 'Accessible to' (A), 'Available to' (B), and 'Can Access' (C) are not the correct tab names.

questions.stem: What action helps to see which modules are visible to a user?
questions.explanation: To see which modules are visible to a user, Impersonate the user. Impersonation allows you to experience the platform exactly as the user does, seeing only the applications and modules their roles permit. Connect Chat (B), Bomgar (A), and NowChat (C) are communication tools, not diagnostic approaches.

questions.stem: What are the different Notification methods that can be used to alert users when events that concern them have occurred? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Notification methods to alert users: Email (B) for electronic mail notifications, SMS (E) for text message alerts, and Meeting Invitation (A) for calendar-based notifications. These are the three notification delivery channels in ServiceNow. Browser Pop ups (C) are not a notification method, and Messenger (D) is a separate communication tool.

questions.stem: What are the steps to apply an update set retrieved from another instance?

options.text: Load the Update Set > Import the Update Set > Install
Verity Update Set is Complete, Retrieve, Preview, Commit
Verify Update Set is Complete, Test Connection, Apply
Import the Update Set > Verify the Update Set is complete > Link the Update Set > Publish

questions.explanation: Steps to apply a retrieved update set: Verify Update Set is Complete (ensure it's in the correct state), Retrieve (pull from remote instance), Preview (check for conflicts), Commit (apply changes). The verification step confirms the update set is marked Complete on the source before migration begins.

questions.stem: After finishing your work on High Security Settings, what is a possible way to return to normal admin security levels?

options.text: Use System Administration > Normal Security module

questions.explanation: After finishing with High Security Settings, log out and back in to return to normal admin security levels. Elevated roles (security_admin) persist for the entire session. Logging out ends the elevated session and a fresh login restores standard admin permissions. There is no 'Normal role' (A), 'Normal Security' module (E), or need to end impersonation (C).

questions.stem: Which feature can be used to give users the choice to easily populate the most-used fields for a specific table?
questions.explanation: Templates give users the ability to easily populate the most-used fields for a specific table with predefined values. When applied, a template auto-fills multiple fields at once, saving time on repetitive data entry. Tags (A) categorize records, Formatters (B) control form layout, and Reference fields (D) link to other tables.

questions.stem: What protects applications by restricting access to data in another application, in the same instance?
questions.explanation: Application Scope protects applications by restricting access to data in another application within the same instance. Scoped applications have isolated tables, scripts, and business logic that other applications cannot access without explicit cross-scope permissions. ACLs (B) control user access, not application-to-application access.

questions.stem: Which module in the Service Catalog application is used to create a new catalog item?
questions.explanation: The Maintain Items module in the Service Catalog application is used to create new catalog items. Navigating to Service Catalog > Catalog Definition > Maintain Items opens the list of all catalog items where you can create new ones. Configuration Items (A) are CMDB CIs, Content Items (C) and Catalog Items (D) are not the correct module names.

questions.stem: What helps to define the structure of a catalog item form that is displayed to the customer?
questions.explanation: Variables define the structure of a catalog item form displayed to the customer. Variables are the form fields (text boxes, checkboxes, dropdowns, etc.) that capture user input when ordering a catalog item. They determine what information the requester provides. Catalog Description (B) is just text, and Order Guides (D) bundle multiple items.

questions.stem: Which displays the list of activities, or history, on a form?
questions.explanation: A Formatter displays the list of activities or history on a form. Specifically, the Activity Formatter renders the activity stream showing journal entries (comments, work notes) and field changes. Formatters are special form elements that display non-field content like activities, process flows, or CI relationships on forms.

questions.stem: Where should an administrator navigate to add the "Save" button in the form header?

options.text: All > System Properties > UI Action Settings

questions.explanation: To add the Save button to the form header, navigate to All > System Properties > UI Properties. This module contains the system property that controls whether the Save button appears in the form header. Form Design (A) and Form Layout (D) manage field arrangement, not header button visibility.

questions.stem: What are the options that can be set to determine when a Business Rule executes? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: The four options for when a Business Rule executes: Before (F) runs before the database operation, After (E) runs after, Async (A) runs asynchronously after the operation in a separate thread, and Display (D) runs when the record is loaded for viewing. Load (B), Change (C), Submit (G), and Click (H) are not Business Rule timing options.

questions.stem: Which access control rule applies to every field in the incident table?
questions.explanation: The ACL rule incident.* applies to every field in the incident table. The wildcard asterisk (*) after the dot means 'all fields'. This is a field-level ACL that covers all columns in the table. incident.None would be a table-level rule, while incident.* specifically targets all individual fields.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of an application scope?

options.text: Scope determines which parts of an application are available for use by other applications In ServiceNow
Scope prevents applications from changing their own tables and business logic
Scope determines the functionality of core services in the platform
Scope determines all applications access each other's tables and business logic

questions.explanation: Application scope determines which parts of an application are available for use by other applications in ServiceNow. It creates boundaries that protect an application's tables, scripts, and configurations from being accessed or modified by other applications without explicit cross-scope access grants.

questions.stem: On a Catalog Task record, how would an administrator change the priority choice options?

options.text: In the Context menu of the form, select Configure Options
Right-click the Priority Label > select Configure Lists
Right-click the Priority Label > select Configure Choices
Open the Data Dictionary > select Values

questions.explanation: To change priority choice options on a Catalog Task record: right-click the Priority Label and select Configure Choices. This opens the choice list editor where you can modify, add, or remove the available priority values. Configure Lists (B) manages list columns. Configure Options (A) is not a standard right-click option.

questions.stem: Which sequence of actions applies an update set to an instance?
questions.explanation: The correct sequence for applying an update set: Retrieve (pull the update set from the remote instance), Preview (check for conflicts and potential issues), Commit (apply the changes to the target instance). This three-step process ensures controlled change management with conflict detection before applying changes.

questions.stem:
A customer asks you to make the following updates to a form:

1. When Caller field is populated, automatically look up caller location and load it in the Location field.
2. Add notice at the top of the page when the record is submitted.

What type of script would you use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: A Client Script meets both requirements: auto-populating the Location field when Caller is set (onChange type) and displaying a notice when the record is submitted (onSubmit type). Client scripts run in the browser and handle form-level events. Both scenarios involve user interaction on the form, making client scripts the appropriate choice.

questions.stem: Where do Ul Policies run?
questions.explanation: UI Policies run client-side (in the browser). They execute JavaScript in the user's web browser to dynamically control form field properties like mandatory, visible, and read-only states based on field conditions. They do not run server-side (C/D) or in a Knowledge Base (B).

questions.stem:
You are creating a catalog item for ordering a new desktop computer. The computers have these options:


Color: Black or Silver -

RAM: 32 MB or 64MB -

Keyboard: Standard or Ergonomic -

Monitor: 24 inch or 32 inch -

How would you add these options to the catalog item form?
questions.explanation: Add Variables to the catalog item form for the computer options (Color, RAM, Keyboard, Monitor). Variables are the catalog item form elements that capture user selections. Each option (Color: Black/Silver, RAM: 32/64MB, etc.) would be a Select Box variable with predefined choices. Variables are the standard way to add options to catalog items.

questions.stem: Which form element displays the list of activities, or history, on a task form?
questions.explanation: The Activity Formatter is the form element that displays the list of activities or history on a task form. It renders journal entries (work notes, additional comments) and field change history in a chronological stream. Action Formatter (A) and Action Stream (C) are not standard ServiceNow terms, and Sidebar (D) is a different UI element.

questions.stem: Which actions can you take to open the Context Menu on a list, form, or column? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the Context Menu related link
Double-click on the list form or column heading
Right-click on the list, form or column heading

questions.explanation: Two ways to open the Context Menu: right-click on the list, form, or column heading (C), or select the Context Menu icon (E) — the three-line/hamburger icon. Double-clicking (B) opens the list editor, not the context menu. Ctrl+M (D) and Context Menu related link (A) are not standard methods.

questions.stem:
Your customer wants to update a notification so it is sent to the Caller's Manager.

Which action supports this requirement?

options.text: On the 'Who will receive' tab on the Notification record add the Caller field, then dot walk to the Caller's Manager field to add it.
On the Notification record create a flow and include a notification in the flow for "All receivers".
On the 'Send to' tab on the Notification record, add the Caller field, then dot walk to the Caller’s Manager field to add it.
On the 'Send to' tab on the Notification record, set "Who will receive" to Subscribable.

questions.explanation: On the 'Who will receive' tab on the Notification record, add the Caller field then dot walk to the Caller's Manager field. Dot walking through reference fields allows you to reach related user fields. The path would be Caller -> Manager, specifying that the notification goes to the caller's manager.

questions.stem: What attributes of a field can a UI Policy Action change on a form? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: UI Policy Actions can change three field attributes on a form: Mandatory (B) to require a value, Visible/Hidden (C) to show or hide the field, and Read Only (E) to prevent editing. UI Policies cannot change field Length (A) or Format (D) — those are Dictionary-level attributes that require schema changes.

questions.stem: Which action enables a user to view and specify date and time formats in their instance?

options.text: Select the User menu > Preferences > Time Settings > Toggle display time zone
Ask the user to adjust the time zone on their personal computer
Use the system properties to correct the instance's time zone
Select the User menu > Preferences > Language & Region > Set date and time format and time zone
Create a UI Script to set the default timezone

questions.explanation: Use the system properties to correct the instance's time zone. System Properties provide global time zone and date/time format configuration for the instance. While individual users can set preferences via User Menu > Preferences, the question asks about enabling users to view date/time formats, which is controlled at the system property level.

questions.stem: A manager is complaining that they can't get the data they need on a report, because the data resides in two different tables. This data is used for many different reports in their department. You have checked to see if dot-walking will meet the requirement, and it is not possible. What else might you try to help this manager?
questions.explanation: Create a Database View to combine data from two different tables when dot-walking is not possible. A Database View creates a virtual table that joins data from multiple tables, making it available as a single report source. This is specifically designed for reporting across tables that don't have direct reference relationships.

questions.stem: Which storefront is a single location for accessing pre-built spokes, to quickly integrate with third party services to build and share content?
questions.explanation: The ServiceNow Store is the storefront for accessing pre-built spokes to integrate with third party services and share content. It's the official marketplace where customers can find and install IntegrationHub spokes, applications, and other content created by ServiceNow and partners. Spoke Store (C) and Integration Spoke Store (B) are not the official names.

questions.stem: Which actions would you take to edit the title on an application menu? (Choose two.)

options.text: Select the Application name on the Navigator, then select the pencil icon
Select System Definitions > Application Menus then select the application
Select Configuration > Applications, then select the application
Select the form for the Application, then right-click, Configure > Form Designer

questions.explanation: Two ways to edit an application menu title: navigate to System Definitions > Application Menus and select the application (C) to edit its properties directly, or select Configuration > Applications and select the application (D) which also provides access to the menu title. Both paths lead to the application menu record where the title can be modified.

questions.stem: Which components are the customer’s responsibility according to the Shared Responsibility Model? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Under ServiceNow's Shared Responsibility Model, customers are responsible for: Authentication and authorization (B) — configuring access controls, roles, SSO, and MFA — and Data encryption at rest (D) — managing encryption of their data within the platform. Infrastructure management (A), media disposal (C), and backup/restore (E) are ServiceNow's responsibility.

questions.stem: Which roles are required to configure the form layout using Table Builder? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: To configure form layout using Table Builder, you need: admin (D) role for full platform administration, and app_engine_admin (C) role which is specifically designed for App Engine Studio and Table Builder capabilities. read_only_user (A) has no write access, it_support_specialist (B) is for ITSM, and personalize_form (E) is for personal view changes only.

questions.stem: An Administrator wants to review all the users having privileged access to identify users that no longer need this level of access. Which Security Center feature can help fulfil this requirement?
questions.explanation: The Security Scanner feature in Security Center helps review all users with privileged access to identify those who no longer need elevated permissions. It scans the instance for security issues including excessive privilege assignments and recommends remediation actions. Security hardening (A) is for configuration, Security posture console (B) is an overview dashboard.

questions.stem: Which Security Center feature helps resolve platform related security issues and misconfigurations?
questions.explanation: The Security Scanner feature in Security Center helps resolve platform-related security issues and misconfigurations. It automatically detects security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and policy violations, then provides actionable recommendations for remediation. Best practices (A) and Customer actions (B) are informational, while Security hardening (C) applies fixes.

questions.stem:
Certain cables have a prefix, like x_.

Which kind of table has a name that starts with this prefix?
questions.explanation: Tables with names starting with the x_ prefix are Scoped Application tables. When a developer creates a table within a scoped application, ServiceNow automatically prepends the x_ prefix followed by the vendor prefix and application name. System tables use sys_, u_ prefix is for user-created custom tables, and there are no 'excluded' or 'explanation' table types.
